articles.title: Indian Navy's latest stealth frigate 'INS Taragiri' commissioned in Visakhapatnam
articles.summary: India's Defence Minister highlighted a new warship as a testament to the nation's increasing technological prowess and self-reliance. This vessel underscores India's formidable naval power, reinforcing its commitment to indigenous defence capabilities and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'. It reflects significant strides in strengthening national security and maritime dominance, crucial for an aspiring naval officer.

articles.title: U.S., Partner Nations Complete Antisubmarine Warfare Exercise
articles.summary: Exercise Sea Dragon 2026 concluded March 28 at Andersen Air Force Base, Guam, after 20 days of intensive multinational operations. Coordinated by U.S. 7th Fleet, this key naval and air exercise enhanced interoperability and maritime domain awareness. Such joint drills are crucial for regional security, demonstrating robust collaborative defence capabilities vital for aspiring officers.

articles.title: Raksha Mantri lays foundation stone of Large Cavitation Tunnel at NSTL, Visakhapatnam to boost naval research & testing capabilities
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that an upcoming project will significantly bolster India's naval power and establish it as a leader in defence technology. This Ministry of Defence initiative is vital for India's strategic positioning, strengthening its maritime capabilities and fostering self-reliance in the global defence sector, reflecting a strong commitment to national security.

articles.title: Why Delhi practised war-like air raid sirens, blackouts & evacuations across 17 locations. Here’s what the drill was about
articles.summary: East Delhi recently conducted a comprehensive civil defence exercise across 17 locations, simulating air raid scenarios, emergency evacuations, and blackout conditions. This large-scale drill aimed to assess and enhance the city's readiness and response capabilities for various emergencies, ensuring civilian safety and infrastructure protection during potential crises and highlighting the importance of urban preparedness.

articles.title: ‘The Kremlin is shifting its tactics to increase civilian suffering,’ Ukrainian officials claim
articles.summary: Russian forces are reportedly shifting their tactics to conduct daytime barrages, specifically targeting key infrastructure across Ukraine. These recent strikes resulted in at least six fatalities yesterday, according to local authorities. This change suggests a strategic intent to disrupt critical services and national resilience, impacting both military and civilian operations amidst the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Macron urges nations not to be ‘vassals’ of the US or China
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron urged nations globally to avoid becoming 'vassals' of the US or China, advocating for greater strategic autonomy. His statement, following a disagreement with then-President Trump over Iran, emphasized a multipolar world where countries pursue independent foreign policies. This reflects France's vision for European sovereignty and a balanced global order, crucial for SSB aspirants studying international relations.
